verdict.why: Ordered criteria 1–3 favor X. The brief requires a taken answer with a backlog row and a date, plus persona configs (device class, language/direction including RTL and double-length, text size, theme), design-review/1 naming those configs and marking only-in-this-configuration, optional stand-cell screenshots, and agent-tester unchanged. X locks that: Goal table Rows A/B due 2026-12-07 and 2026-12-21, a verbatim board reply, R1–R16 with exit codes and planted messages, Contracts (vocabulary, bands, report JSON, stand manifest), and D1–D21 closing the tactical questions (Q3–Q21). A zero-context implementer can build the gate and the reply without asking. Y does not: Rollout step 5 is still "<id>" / "<date 1>", Q2 leaves the dates pending the owner, and Q5–Q6 leave the door fetch unbuildable, so item 2 and the required dated answer are missing. Y is the simpler alternative a sceptic prefers (C1 object config, two text values, decline line, local stand-captures/1, no edge caps) and invents less, but C7/T-19 make a missing --build only a warning, the report config omits direction, and C1’s locale regex accepts en-XA without counting double-length. Those are holes, not a smaller complete spec. X’s own sceptic failures are real but lower-order: R3’s six-edge quota, ≤2 edges, and ≥2 zero-edge personas are not in the brief and Q1 is still pending; Vocabulary adds desktop and text=large beyond the owner’s small/large phone and tablet and “largest”; device bands invent dead zones (376–389, 431–743, 1025–1279); non-goals say the stand is not changed while Row B demands a new stand manifest the facts never describe (only test-stand.sshlg and a per-sender key); D14 drops untagged explore despite the brief naming explore; R6’s seven-item CHECKS tuple is not in the facts.
risks: X Q1 is pending while R3/R11 already fail or NOT_RUN products that do not owe every edge; if the owner rejects universal RTL/dark coverage, the waiver constitution and its fixtures are rework.
Row B’s manifest is an invented stand API. If the door does not serve that JSON, item 2 slips past 2026-12-21 or is rewritten; untagged explore still cannot fill a row (D14).
Repo assumptions not in the facts (CHECKS length 7, classes flagship/product/ad, com.get, git diff <base>, secret-runner variable) can make R6/R12/R16 fail on contact with the tree.
Direction is only pseudo-rtl or primary ar/he/fa/ur, so script overrides and other RTL languages are wrong; the web text-doubling script can manufacture findings X’s own Risks section already flags.
